The <c:ffff00>skills<c> used for anything other than <c:ffff00>attacking<c>, or
their corresponding <c:ffff00>{{skill_level}}<c>: <c:ffff00>Support<c>, <c:ffff00>Heal<c>, <c:ffff00>Block<c>
and <c:ffff00>Set-up<c>. The others are <c:ffff00>offensive<c>.

The higher these skill levels, the faster the <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c>
and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> of actions and the higher the <c:ffff00>{{defend}}<c>
and <c:ffff00>{{evade}}<c>. The speed-up in {{prep}} and {{cooldown}} is
greater than for offensive skills.
